verse.verse_1: When the sky is torn apart,
verse.verse_2: hearing and obeying its Lord, as it must do;
verse.verse_3: when the earth is stretched out
verse.verse_4: and casts out all that is within and voids itself,
verse.verse_5: obeying its Lord, as it must do!
verse.verse_6: O human, you are working hard towards your Lord and you will meet Him.
verse.verse_7: Then, he who is given his Book in his right hand
verse.verse_9: and will return rejoicing to his family.
verse.verse_10: But he who is given his Book from behind his back
verse.verse_13: Once, he lived joyfully among his family
verse.verse_14: and surely thought he would never return (to his Lord).
verse.verse_15: Yes indeed, his Lord was ever watching him.
verse.verse_17: by the night and all that it envelops;
verse.verse_18: by the moon, in its fullness
verse.verse_19: that you shall surely ride from stage to stage.
verse.verse_20: What is the matter with them, that they do not believe
verse.verse_21: and when the Koran is recited to them that they do not prostrate!
verse.verse_23: and Allah knows very well what they gather.
verse.verse_24: Therefore give to them glad tidings of a painful punishment,
verse.verse_25: except to those who believe, and do righteous deeds, for theirs is an unfailing recompense.
